answer.original_source: NN, Inc., as reported by finance.yahoo.com; the announcement date is not specified beyond late June 2026.
answer.new_information: NN reportedly announced it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. The article also reports NN's claim that the new capacity was fully pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and its 2026 target of US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business. These are NN supplier-capacity and business-target claims, not NVIDIA guidance or a reported NVIDIA result; the business target is for 2026 and should not be treated as NVIDIA revenue.
